checks.name: output_map_share_is_static_and_opt_in
checks.run:
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
module_path = Path('factoryline/output_map.py')
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('candidate_output_map', module_path)
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
assert spec.loader is not None
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
with TemporaryDirectory() as value:
    root = Path(value)
    receipt = module.write_output_map(root, name='starter', source_sha256='0' * 64, status='blocked')
    text = (root / receipt['path']).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert '## Optional sharing' in text
    assert 'Code Factory does not post it, edit other files, or send output data' in text
    assert '[Built with Code Factory](https://github.com/zrk222/code-factory)' in text
